topography.project_purpose: Chain. Structurally: 30 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable, clone). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
